criticalFindings.description: DynamicMeshManager.ts, FSIRelaxationManager.ts, FSICouplingManager.ts, FSIInterface.ts, FSIPhysicsModel.ts, and HardAcceptanceGate254.ts contain only 2 lines (export class ClassName {}) with zero implementation.
criticalFindings.impact: Features advertised by file names do not exist as callable code in those files.

criticalFindings.description: TwoWayFSICouplingEngine.ts computes structural displacement using an artificial formula (stiffness = E * 1e-7; d = F / stiffness) and breaks after 1 iteration, bypassing actual finite element analysis.
criticalFindings.impact: FSI coupling produces 25% interface force imbalance and is physically ungrounded until wired to StructuralAnalysisEngine.runFEA.

criticalFindings.description: src/engine/cfd3d/solvers/fsi/index.ts exports mock FSISolver returning synthetic sine wave displacements, HardAcceptanceGate254 returning hardcoded PASS with mock metrics, and FSIBenchmarkSuite returning static PASS results.
criticalFindings.impact: Frontend FsiWorkspace.tsx receives fabricated simulation data instead of executing the actual physics engine.

criticalFindings.description: FSIInterfaceMapper.ts uses faceId as a proxy for structural nodeId rather than geometric projection, nearest-neighbor, or RBF.
criticalFindings.impact: Load transfer is constrained to synthetic test meshes with 1:1 node/face correspondence.

prioritizedRemediationRoadmap.action: Completed in SECP-ENGINE-QUALIFICATION-002-FSI-STRUCTURAL-SOLVER-QUALIFICATION-001 (Analytical rod test error < 0.0001%, NAFEMS Quad4 PASS).
Wire StructuralAnalysisEngine.runFEA into the iterative partitioned Gauss-Seidel loop, replacing stiffness = E * 1e-7 with actual FEA solution and unpenalized reaction forces.
Implement Laplacian / Spring boundary smoothing for fluid mesh vertex coordinates, check Jacobian determinant for inversion, and reject collapsed elements.
Implement genuine Aitken dynamic under-relaxation computing omega_k = -omega_{k-1} * (r_{k-1}^T * (r_k - r_{k-1})) / ||r_k - r_{k-1}||^2, residual monitoring, and divergence detection.

prioritizedRemediationRoadmap.component: FSI Solvers Index & Acceptance Gate Refactoring
prioritizedRemediationRoadmap.action: Eliminate hardcoded arrays and empty stubs in index.ts; delegate directly to validated TwoWayFSICouplingEngine and actual gate criteria.
